seo.title: Luis Schulz – Pro triathlete and coach
seo.description: Luis Schulz, pro triathlete and coach from the Munich area: races, personal coaching, talks and partnerships.

heroTitle:
Luis Schulz.
Pro triathlete and coach.
heroText: Based in the Munich area, with a passion for long-distance racing. Plus personal coaching for a small number of athletes.
introText:
It all started with running in 2020; triathlon followed at the end of 2022 and hasn't let go since. The best races so far: two starts at Challenge Roth, an age group win (AK 20) in 2025 and a top 10 finish among all age-groupers in 2026.

In coaching, sports science is the foundation, but the person is at the centre. Finding the right approach for each athlete is the most rewarding part.

pillars.title: Coaching
pillars.text: Personal support, training planned in TrainingPeaks and replies within 3 hours.

pillars.title: Talks
pillars.text: Talks and workshops for clubs and teams, for example on nutrition around training and competition.

pillars.title: Partners
pillars.text: For companies that want to support a pro triathlete long-term.

quote: We don't make progress in our comfort zone. Just like in other areas of life, in sport we go the extra mile together.
ctaText: Coaching, talks, partnerships or press: every message is read and answered personally.
